items.source: A GeneratorStrategy suitable for use with Enhancer which causes all undeclared exceptions thrown from within a proxied method to be wrapped in an alternative exception of your choice.
items.translation: 适合与Enhancer一起使用的GeneratorStrategy，它会导致从代理方法中抛出的所有未声明异常被包装为您选择的替代异常。

items.source:
CGLIB GeneratorStrategy variant which exposes the application ClassLoader
as current thread context ClassLoader for the time of class generation.
items.translation: CGLIB GeneratorStrategy 变体，在类生成期间将应用程序的 ClassLoader 暴露为当前线程上下文 ClassLoader。
